name: intellilearn-web
description: CS3613 AI Study Platform - Reverse engineered and web-ready edition

scripts.start: node -e "import('http').then(h => import('fs').then(f => import('path').then(p => import('child_process').then(cp => { const port = 3613; const mime = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.woff': 'font/woff', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.ttf': 'font/ttf', '.md': 'text/markdown' }; h.createServer((req, res) => { let url = req.url.split('?')[0]; if (url === '/' || url === '') url = '/index.html'; const file = p.join(process.cwd(), decodeURIComponent(url)); if (f.existsSync(file) && !f.statSync(file).isDirectory()) { const ext = p.extname(file).toLowerCase(); res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': mime[ext] || 'application/octet-stream', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' }); f.createReadStream(file).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(port, () => { console.log(`IntelliLearn running at http://localhost:${port}`); cp.exec(`start http://localhost:${port}`); }); }))));"
